# run

# note framed by rr, not by the wire
>>> f.rr
-- indents a json response --
GET {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1

>>> want f.rr
-- indents a json response --
GET {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1

HTTP/1.1 200 OK

{
  "ok": true,
